 Prayer:

Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 to issue a Writ of
 Certiorarified Mandamus calling for the records of the 4th responde
 issued the notice bearing under section 28(2) (ii) of Tamil Nadu
 Highway Act 2001, dated 08.04.2024 and quash the same and
 consequentially direct the respondents to consider the representati
 dated 06.04.2024 and received by respondent on 08.04.2024 and
 review and disburse the compensation amount to the petitioner.

For Respondents : Mr. A.Selvendran
 Special Government Pleader.

Order 
The petitioner is before this Court challenging the impugned notice issued under Section 28 (2) (ii)
of the Tamil Nadu Highways Act 2001, alleging that the procedure contemplated under the Tamil Nadu Highways Act, had not been followed.

Further, though the lands proposed to be acquired as per the notice dated 27.09.2017 under Section 19 (2), measures an extent of 31 sq.mts., however, the p e t i t i o n e r h a s b e e n i n f o r m e d t h a t 4 1 s q . m t s . , w o u l d b e a c q u i r e d a n d t h e https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis impugned notice is now in furtherance of the above.

2. Heard the learned counsels on the either side and perused the records.
3.

The writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the 3rd and 4th respondents that they shall at the outset measure 31 sq.mts., for which acquisition proceedings have been initiated and only after marking the same shall proceed with further acquisition proceedings.
They shall not acquire and take possession an inch beyond 31 sq.mts., in the petitioner's land, which is the subject matter of the notice dated 27.09.2017.
Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
